 Follow ‘Fixer Upper’ to Return With New Spinoff Series as Chip & Joanna Gaines Renovate a Mansion
 AJ Pitts Updated Fri, October 23, 2026 at 1:05 AM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Magnolia Network Fixer Upper is making a comeback!
 It's been a year since the last installment, Fixer Upper: Colorado Mountain Home , and hosts Chip and Joanna Gaines are taking on a massive new project in Fixer Upper: Chip Bought a Mansion on Magnolia Network and HGTV.
 What is the new Fixer Upper about?
 In Fixer Upper: Chop Bought a Mansion , the popular HGTV and Magnolia Network couple have "three months to transform a 15,000-square-foot Waco estate that Chip purchased three years ago. What began as an exciting investment quickly became a massive undertaking when they discovered the property needed far more work than anticipated. Now, Jo will step in to help transform the outdated property into a beautiful home ready for its next chapter."
 The six-episode series take viewers inside every step of the transformation as Chip and Jo navigate unexpected setbacks, budget challenges and the unique opportunities that come with renovating a property of this scale. In the premiere, the couple hosts a pre-renovation open house to gather feedback from realtors and the community as they develop a plan for the massive project ahead. To help shape her vision, Jo leans on her designer friends for guidance and a fresh perspective. Then, as work gets underway; Chip searches for creative ways to offset costs, including selling salvaged materials from the property, while Jo focuses on balancing the home's character with her signature design style.
 Throughout the season, Jo will travel to East Texas in search of unique pieces for the mansion, while Chip will try his hand at landscaping and styling. As the renovation nears completion, the couple will put the finishing touches on the property before welcoming real estate professionals back to experience the dramatic reveal and see whether the ambitious project was worth the risk.
 What Joanna Gaines says about the new series
 " Chip has always been a dreamer and risk taker, but even for him, buying a mansion was a bold move," Joanna shared in a statement. "What started as a surprise quickly turned into one of our most ambitious and unique renovations to date. It challenged us creatively and stretched our comfort zones, but my favorite part was that Chip and I really got to work side by side in order to get this massive house across the finish line and on the market."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "What makes this project so entertaining is that it begins with a big idea that only Chip could dream up," Allison Page , President of Magnolia Network, said. "As the renovation unfolds, viewers will experience every twist and turn alongside Chip and Joanna while watching them navigate a project unlike anything they've tackled before. It's unpredictable, fun, and a compelling next chapter in the Fixer Upper story."
 When does Fixer Upper: Chip Bought a Mansion premiere?
 The upcoming six-episode series is set to debut on Sunday, December 27th at 9 and 9:30 pm ET/PT on Magnolia Network and HGTV.
 Episodes will also be available to stream the next day on HBO Max.
